field_checks.summary: Requested roots and files were readable. Core paper/packet final mirrors are byte-identical for activity, database, mechanism ontology, and review; packet mechanism_evidence is an identical alias. Counts are 56 activity, 16 toxicity, 37 database audits, 5 mechanism claims, and 0 review rework targets. The mirror inventory is not one-to-one because paper final has materials_manifest while packet final has the mechanism_evidence alias.

Mechanism ontology preserves several direct membrane/microscopy boundaries, but it omits the source-backed LPS/DsPMB displacement binding mechanism as a direct assay and instead leaves direct binding keyword candidates nonpromoted.

Paper DOI/PMID/PMCID/title are traceable, but entity linkage is not publication-grade: final candidate identities for EB9, PMB2, EB12, EB13, EB16, EB18, EB21, and EB22 carry sequence None even though source sequence/modification notations and ring-closure markers are present.

Locator roots are present, but normalization/provenance is not clean: the CSV-named supplement is a readable HTML challenge page, supplementary table cells are unresolved, Table 1 conditions are absent from final activity rows, and MDR footnote markers remain embedded in strain fields.

Fallback release boundary is preserved because authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false and fallback rows are machine-only, but recursive acceptance boundary is not clean: the strict audit and final review report claim gate-clean publication grade while source inspection shows hard material/activity/toxicity/mechanism omissions.

The database no-authoritative-link caution is preserved, but the final caution set does not preserve the malformed S2 CSV, unresolved supplementary table cells, omitted HK-2 toxicity row, or omitted LPS binding mechanism as cautions or rework targets.

Supplementary source coverage is not exhausted. S1 PDF text is staged and readable, but S2 CSV is not the XML-declared data asset and structured extraction for endpoint-bearing supplementary tables is explicitly unresolved while material status is complete.

Final toxicity coverage includes MHC values for selected compounds and HEK293 IC50 values, but omits the source Table S5 HK-2 IC50 row and additional MHC/selectivity values in supplementary tables; final records contain no HK-2 target at all.

blocking_findings.reason: Mechanism ontology omits a direct mechanism claim for LPS binding measured by Dansyl-PMB displacement. The source states that the fluorescence displacement assay indicated binding to lipopolysaccharide, the main target of PMB2, and Figure 2g plus supplementary methods/pages provide assay conditions. The final mechanism record instead excludes direct binding keyword candidates as not promoted, leaving a source-backed direct assay surface unrepresented.
required_actions: Add a source-backed mechanism claim for LPS/DsPMB displacement binding, or provide a specific source-reviewed nonpromotion rationale that distinguishes this assay from keyword noise.
Classify the LPS binding claim with an appropriate evidence_class and direct_assay_types, preserving limitations such as paper-level rather than database-record-level scope.
Re-run mechanism QA against XML Figure 2g, main-text mechanism paragraph, and supplementary pages 37-39.
acceptance_checks: mechanism_claims contains a stable claim_id and claim_text for LPS/DsPMB displacement binding, or excluded_or_nonpromoted_evidence contains an explicit assay-specific reason tied to the source locators.
